g.text: Database Replication & Failover: what happens when the primary dies
A failover timeline, and the read-after-write staleness bug it creates downstream
W5 was in flight to the primary
W5 was confirmed to the client, but never left the primary before it died.
The promoted replica has no record of it -- not delayed, gone.
Read-After-Write Staleness (a downstream bug from the same lag, not a separate failure)
This is "read-after-write consistency," not eventual consistency being broken.
Fix: read this user's own writes from the primary briefly, or route to a caught-up replica.
